artifact.description: Retrieve the phone number for a specified member_id; returns member_phone (string).

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: Member ID entered into the 'Member ID' field to search for the member record.

selection_context.use_when: You need to obtain the phone number for a specific member and you can provide the member's member_id; the automation will search for and open the member record and return the phone number.
selection_context.workflow_summary: Given a member_id, the workflow searches for and opens that member's record and extracts the member's phone number, returning it as member_phone.
example_goals: Get the phone number of member 12345
Find the contact number for member 12345
Retrieve the phone for member ID 12345
Lookup the phone number for member 12345
Show me the phone number for member 12345
